title: Grateful Dead Live at Public Hall on 1973-12-06

ai_review.summary: Pitch‑perfect soundboard recording highlights an epic, extended “Here Comes Sunshine” with crystal‑clear audio.
ai_review.review: The upgraded SBD capture is described as a “Gold Standard” – pitch‑corrected, balanced and exceptionally clear, turning the show into one of the year’s best recordings. Reviewers especially praise the longest version of “Here Comes Sunshine,” noting its energy and seamless integration into an otherwise flawless performance.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 5‑star ratings, consistently praising both the musical performance and the upgraded soundboard quality; the consensus is strong and detailed.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Pitch correction applied, superb bass balance, clean mix with no audible drop‑outs or muddiness; described as “Gold Standard” soundboard quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert flows smoothly with high energy throughout, highlighted by an especially long and powerful “Here Comes Sunshine” that anchors the performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: No specific musical comments, but reviewers mention hoping Jerry is smiling – indicating general satisfaction.
